title: Administrator Portion Withheld from Cancelled Waivers
content:
# Administrator Portion Withheld from Cancelled Waivers

*Excerpt of the program administrator terms, Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda; the deal type is read from the group's Vehicle Purchase Agreements records.*

On a holder's cancellation of a Kessler GAP waiver, part of the waiver's price is kept by the program administrator. The portion kept depends on the deal type of the Vehicle Purchase Agreement on which the waiver was sold, read from that purchase deal's record.

| Deal type of the waiver's Vehicle Purchase Agreement | Portion withheld from the price |
|---|---|
| New Vehicle Retail Purchase | 40.00 |
| New Vehicle Factory Order Purchase | 40.00 |
| Used Vehicle Retail Purchase | 60.00 |
| Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Purchase | 60.00 |
| Value Line Used Vehicle Purchase | 60.00 |
| Any other deal type (for example a Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement) | Nothing |

The portion is withheld from the waiver's price before the unused share is applied: the refund on the unused part of the term is figured on the price less the portion withheld.

## Illustration (hypothetical figures)

A waiver priced 643.00 with an unused share of 1,500 over 2,191 calendar days:

- sold on a New Vehicle Retail Purchase: 643.00 less 40.00 is 603.00; 603.00 times 1,500 divided by 2,191 is 412.8251..., rounded to 412.83;
- sold on a Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Purchase: 643.00 less 60.00 is 583.00; times the same share is 399.1328..., rounded to 399.13;
- sold on a Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement: nothing is withheld and the share applies to the full 643.00.

## Basis note

The deal type is the one recorded on the Vehicle Purchase Agreement that carries the waiver, not the type of any later purchase by the holder.
